verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent spec, and probes of the standard paths (/openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. The interactive playground, Markdown versions of pages and llms.txt index are docs-oriented features next to this story, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit. The axis applies to a product with a public API, so the verdict is none rather than na.
